# createPersonNote — POST /people/{vanId}/notes

Add a note to a person

## Verified behaviors

- **Creating a note returns nothing — the id has to be read back** — Success is a bare 204: no body, no Location header, no noteId. The only way to learn the new id is GET /people/{vanId}/notes. The read-back also shows `isPinned` was accepted and ignored, and that an uncategorized note reads as the `{noteCategoryId: 0, name: null}` stub. ([replay](../behaviors/note-create-is-silent.md))
- **A view-restricted note can be written but never read back** — `isViewRestricted: true` is accepted with the same 204 as any other note, and the note is then withheld from API keys entirely: absent from items and not counted in count, so every note the API ever shows has the flag false. ([replay](../behaviors/restricted-notes-vanish-from-the-api.md))

## Behavior

Creates a note on the person.

On success the response is **204 No Content** with an empty body: the new `noteId` is not returned and there is no `Location` header, so the only way to learn it is to read the notes back. Two notes with identical text are two separate notes — the endpoint is not idempotent.

`isPinned` is accepted and ignored; notes always read back `isPinned: false`. Unknown fields are ignored too. A `contactHistory` object records a Contact History entry alongside the note, but the note's own `contactHistory` stays null in every response.

A note saved with `isViewRestricted: true` can be written but never read back through the API — it is excluded from `GET /people/{vanId}/notes` and from `$expand=notes` on the person.

## Differs from the official docs

- **parameters / vanId** — Official docs type this path parameter as string (default "100476252"); the route only matches integers (observed 2026-08-04).

## Example

```bash
curl -sS -X POST \
  'https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/102714507/notes' \
  -u "app-name:$NGP_API_KEY|1" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "text": "Great chat! This person will be able to volunteer next year."
}'
```
